title: Liberals enjoying strong public support over Canada-U.S. trade war, but final deal will determine Grit fortunes, say political players - The Hill Times
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Liberals enjoying strong public support over Canada-U.S. trade war, but final deal will determine Grit fortunes, say political players - The Hill Times

The success or failure of any potential trade deal with the U.S. will depend on the reaction of provincial premiers, especially Ontario and Quebec, says pollster Nik Nanos, who also says Mark Carney's strategy right now is like Muhammad Ali's 'rope-a-dope' boxing strategy: he's absorbing pressure from Washington and will push back when the timing is right.

Actual Article Body:
